title: Theo and the Debt
author: Tamsin Joubert
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
